creativity.reason: Level 1: the business is HCM/payroll software, and creative work appears only as routine marketing content (podcasts, blogs, television advertising), so this rests on general description with no creates or enables activity.

community.reason: Level 2: the filing shows employee development (E1, E2) and a Paycom Learning course offering (E3), but discloses no reach figures for the external education product, so it does not reach level 3.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: applications offered in 15 languages (E4) are a specific customer-access practice, but no measured reach of language users is disclosed; demographics (E5) and the inclusive-workplace statement add no more than level 1.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the company serves small businesses as clients (E6), but there is no specific program aimed at barriers to starting or growing a business, and its target clients run from 50 to 10,000+ employees with a stated push toward larger employers.

evidence.activity: Company learning tool gives employees tailored learning paths in leadership, inclusion, technical skills and compliance
evidence.quote: Through the use of our Paycom learning tool, we empower our employees by providing tailored learning paths in areas such as leadership, inclusion, technical skills and compliance.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Training and Development

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Intensive training program for the sales force, with weekly sessions and leadership development
evidence.quote: Our unique training program includes instruction in accounting, business metrics, application features and tax matters relevant to our target market, and we believe it fosters loyalty and helps maintain our corporate culture.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Training and Development

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Paycom Learning product sells a library of Paycom-created training courses to client organizations
evidence.quote: Paycom content subscriptions are also available with hundreds of courses in English and Spanish.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Our Applications and Tools > Talent Management > Paycom Learning

community.criterion: level 2: specific current education offering, limited in disclosed reach (one module among many, no revenue or user figures, largely compliance topics)

evidence.activity: HCM applications, including Employee Self-Service, offered in multiple languages
evidence.quote: With Global HCM, a number of our HCM applications and tools are available in 15 languages and dialects and are accessible to users in more than 190 countries.
evidence.indicators: 15 languages and dialects; more than 190 countries

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: multilingual product access with no measured reach of language users

evidence.activity: Discloses EEO-1 workforce demographics for U.S. employees
evidence.quote: The demographic workforce data within the table below, including race and ethnicity, gender and job categories, aligns with the EEO-1 Component 1 data collection reporting requirements outlined by the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, where applicable, and includes U.S.-based employees only.

evidence.activity: Emerging markets sales representatives focus on very small business clients
evidence.quote: Our sales force is comprised of field sales personnel, who are organized geographically, CRRs, who sell additional applications to existing clients, and our emerging markets representatives, who focus on businesses with fewer than 65 employees.

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: small-business customers with no specific enabling service

notes: Items not counted: training clients' employees to use the Paycom app is product onboarding and customer education (a trap); 'foundation' in Item 7 means payroll is the base product; the 'Learning' library topics are largely compliance (harassment, workplace violence), which supports keeping Community at 2. Employee Self-Service in 15 languages is treated as the same multilingual activity as E4 and not counted twice, and the Spanish courses in E3 are not separately counted for Cross-cultural. International availability in more than 190 countries does not count on its own; only the language support counts. The affirmative action plan is described as a government-contractor compliance requirement and is not counted. The inclusion learning paths in E1 are recorded for Community only, as a conservative choice. Paycom states it is moving toward larger clients, which weakens any small-business enabling reading.
